corrections: AUTOMATIC PATH STAGED. RequireInitialResync now enters REQUESTING_FULL_SYNC and zeroes the counters, and the adapter signals WAITING_FOR_PMS once the initial DR has been accepted by the existing serialized writer. DS/DE, staging and the atomic publish are untouched; no second resync mechanism exists.
TRANSPORT LOST BEFORE DS is now FAILED rather than silence. INTERRUPTED still covers loss mid-roster, where a mirror was staged but never published.

SINGLE DUAL-RATE POLL. The Synchronization card polls whenever mounted - 10s idle, 3s during a sync - as ONE interval whose delay changes, so a rate change replaces the timer instead of adding one. Polling only while active could never observe the event that starts a sync, which is exactly the reconnect the operator is watching.
SKIPPED IS PER ROSTER. skippedNoIdentity and its report watermark reset at DS, where received already resets. It was a per-ownership-cycle total, so a second sync inherited the first one's rejects.
